msg: Bonjour! Nous sommes 3 amis français à Cartagena et on voudrait faire du snorkeling demain. Un de nous a le mal de mer, c'est un problème? Comment on réserve?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Snorkeling in the Rosario Islands is a lovely way to enjoy the reef, and the tour includes two guided sessions, snorkeling gear, lunch, boat transport, park entry and activity insurance.

One of you gets seasick? That doesn’t automatically rule out the trip, but the boat ride from Cartagena takes about an hour each way, so it’s worth considering. I don’t have specific seasickness guidance to share.

To book for tomorrow, choose your date and all 3 people through the online booking link. The system closes bookings for the next day at 4:30 p.m.; it’s currently 7:13 a.m. in Cartagena, so you can still book today. Meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; the estimated return to Cartagena is around 4:15 p.m.

[Book the Snorkeling Tour](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en)

🤿 *Snorkeling Tour*
💰 *126 USD* per person (online rate) · 3 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, activity insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided sessions with a local guide, snorkeling equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
